messages.subject: delay the reactive component text-input
parts: I have a data frame full of names of different species and it's saved in back-end of the server. In the UI part I have a textInput window. So the idea is i enter a string to the textInput, the server-side performs grep on all species, finding the one i need and then performs calculation. However the problem is, that when I enter the first letter it retrieves the first field which contains that letter  (in alphabetical order) and triggers the calculations. What i want to do, is to delay the update time of reactive component such as text field or slider, so that user could have at least one second before triggering the search and calculations based on that search.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: delay the reactive component text-input
parts:
If the search is expensive, you might consider using submitButton. You could also return no results if less than, say, 3 letters are entered.

There is a way to do what you want, it involves some JavaScript though. Paste the following chunk somewhere in your UI (in sidebarPanel or mainPanel would be fine). The operative section is bolded.

tags$script("
  var slowTextInputBinding = new Shiny.InputBinding();
  $.extend(slowTextInputBinding, {
    find: function(scope) {
      return $(scope).find('input[type=\"text\"]');
    },
    getId: function(el) {
      return Shiny.InputBinding.prototype.getId.call(this, el) || el.name;
    },
    getValue: function(el) {
      return el.value;
    },
    setValue: function(el, value) {
      el.value = value;
    },
    subscribe: function(el, callback) {
      $(el).on('keyup.textInputBinding input.textInputBinding', function(event) {
        callback(true);
      });
      $(el).on('change.textInputBinding', function(event) {
        callback(false);
      });
    },
    unsubscribe: function(el) {
      $(el).off('.textInputBinding');
    },
    getRatePolicy: function() {
      return {
        policy: 'debounce',
        delay: 1000
      };
    }
  });
  Shiny.inputBindings.register(slowTextInputBinding, 'slowTextInput');
");
